import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    S = params[0] + params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]*t) + params[3]*t*np.exp(-params[4]*t) + params[5]*np.exp(-params[6]*t)/(t+params[7])
    return S - params[8]*t**2*A**params[9]
